public_rationale: The evaluation date is the publication date. The predicted future quarters have not elapsed, and no event meets the early-resolution rule. The S-1 establishes existing commitments, but those commitments alone do not prove that operating profitability will reverse or that revenue growth cannot offset the costs.
limitations: September 2027 is an operational interpretation of few quarters, not an explicit deadline.
A liability, expense and cash payment may occur at different times.
The outcome needs attribution to the specified obligations, not merely evidence of any future loss.

our_interpretation: The preceding discussion of a profitable Q2 makes the ordinary reading a reversal into operating losses or material operating-margin pressure caused by compute obligations.
Balance sheet is used loosely for financial strain. Signing a commitment does not by itself establish an expense, recognized liability or loss.

Interpret the next few quarters as the next three to four reporting quarters from publication, covering Q4 2026 through Q3 2027. Use September 30, 2027 as the outer operational deadline, while flagging that the speaker supplied no exact count.
Regardless of performance makes this an unconditional forecast, not a forecast contingent on weak revenue.
The contract's metric_scope captures the profitability outcome; commitment terms and payments require separate contextual measurements.
criteria.support_condition: Results within the interpreted horizon show operating losses or material deterioration from Q2 profitability, with disclosures attributing a material part of that pressure to payments or expenses under the non-cancellable compute obligations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Across the interpreted horizon, comparable operating profitability is maintained or improves while the relevant commitments take effect, without the predicted financial strain. Strong revenue alone is insufficient.
